author: Ashutosh M.
verbatim_text: Worst support when you need it the most. Today, I added funds to my account. The amount was debited from my bank account but was not credited to my Zerodha account. To make matters worse, every customer support number I tried either disconnected after one ring or remained constantly busy. This is extremely frustrating, especially when timely support is critical. Based on my experience, I would not recommend using this app for trading.

author: Abhinay S.
verbatim_text: My experience with Zerodha Kite has been mixed. The app interface is clean, smooth, and very easy to use, which makes trading convenient even for beginners. However, the charges feel a bit high, including annual fees and other hidden costs that are not always clear. It would be better if pricing was more transparent. Overall, good usability but costs could be lower.

author: Kishan A.
verbatim_text: My bank account has been blocked due to an unexpected transaction from Groww. I did not initiate or withdraw any money, yet funds were automatically credited to my account. It has been almost a month, and my account is still blocked. As a result, my EMI and SIP payments cannot be processed, and I may not receive my salary. This has caused serious financial stress. Please investigate this issue urgently, clarify why the transaction occurred, and help resolve the matter at the earliest.

author: Palash M.
verbatim_text: Groww is very easy to use compared to many apps, which I really like. However, there is no separate category or dedicated section for International Mutual Funds, making it difficult to find all available funds. I’ve also noticed that international funds currently not accepting new SIPs or lump-sum investments don’t even appear when searched in the app. This is very disappointing and frustrating. Because of these issues, I’m giving Groww a 1-star review.

author: mdimran m.
verbatim_text: I am extremely disappointed with the Angel One trading app. For the past month, it has frequently malfunctioned and often fails to open or load properly—approximately 70% of the time. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app, but the problem has still not been resolved. More seriously, the app sometimes displays the chart of a different stock than the one selected, across multiple time frames. This critical error could lead to incorrect trading decisions and significant financial losses.

author: bala s.
verbatim_text: Waste app with hidden brokerage charges. Don't use this app if you are a long-term delivery investor. Brokerage charges are added to your purchase cost, increasing your average buy price and reducing your returns. I paid a significant amount in brokerage for small delivery orders. There are better brokers with zero brokerage for equity delivery. Very disappointing experience.

author: Kaushiki K.
verbatim_text: I am using Paytm money from 2021. Earlier I never had any issue using the app. But now days I am experiencing a lot problems. Some hidden charges are applied and there is no explanation for that. The shares bought at low price will always be credited to your account at a higher price than the price at which you placed the order. So, there is always some deduction in your money for which you will have no explanation. Worst customer support.

author: Prakash T.
verbatim_text: They are living in the era when stocks were issued on a hard paper. They don't have a way to do reKYC online if your investment account gets Dormant due to the inactivity. You will get the confirmation from the AMCs that the NAVs have been allocated but the app stay in another world and take ages to update it and keeps showing InProgress. They don't even have a Customer Support. Stay away from this application and explore other good platforms like Kuvera, Kite, Grows, etc. Don't waste time here.

author: Sattison A.
verbatim_text: I have been this app for 4 years and it used to be so good. It also had expense tracking. And was very simple to use. Now they have made it into an utter mess. I can't find my profit and loss reports (for tax filing). It does not allow you to check your credit score anymore. It has become more of a selling platform, wherein they charge you to even track external portfolios. This is insane. No other platforms do this. There are better platforms to switch to, like Groww, IndMoney, Kuvera, etc.

author: Rishav G.
verbatim_text: They are making the app more predatory and less useful with every update. There are a million paid options you can access (Genius, insights, paid reports etc.) within seconds of opening the app, but even after trying for 5 minutes, I couldn't find the breakdown of my fund portfolio, or a way to withdraw my investments, which used to be very simple in the beginning. I can only see the total portfolio value now. I bet you assume people don't pick up on the intent behind these changes.

author: @ervi***
verbatim_text: Don't be misguided. For new people or those who can't spend time daily looking at the market ups and downs or those who need hand holding, mutual fund is the best option. A good AMC can generate good return with much stability than what direct stocks could provide. These kind of people want to misguide investors so that they can sell their course. Invest in mutual fund and keep learning and implementing your knowledge on markets. Mutual funds provide you the needed cushion. I am an Electrical Engineer having very little knowledge about the market. I entered market in 2020 and bought MF units to begin with. Today they have generated much better returns and with stability which has increased my risk capacity to invest directly in the market by learning how it all works.
